audit.note: the trigger press round-trips and on_event builds the fragment's ResponsivePopover with the f:ProductSwitch, anchored by id via popover_display (the app-165 shape); fnChange toasts and redirects off ${$parameters>/itemPressed}.getTargetSrc() through two chained client actions; the phone-only Close endButton closes with popover_close.

deviations.what: The view is the trigger Button plus two explanatory Texts; the ProductSwitch lives in ProductSwitchItemWithImageSrc.fragment.xml, which onInit loads once and fnOpen opens at pSwitchBtn (openBy). The port rebuilds the fragment as a core:FragmentDefinition in on_event and shows it with popover_display( by_id = pSwitchBtn ) - the documented fragment-popover path of app 165. The three ProductSwitchItem controls stay static 1:1 (the original binds no model). fnChange - MessageToast 'Redirecting to <targetSrc>' plus URLHelper.redirect( targetSrc, true ) - is two client actions chained on the one change event, both reading the pressed item off the event (${$parameters>/itemPressed}.getTargetSrc()).

onInit gives the popover an Emphasized 'Close' endButton on a phone only (Device.system.phone), wired to fnClose. The branch stays a branch, as in app 165: the Button is declared once with visible bound to {= ${device>/system/phone} } and closes with the roundtrip-free popover_close action - so the port carries 2 Button controls where the original view declares 1, the second being the controller-built one.

The imageSrc assets are host-absolutized to https://sdk.openui5.org/ (test-resources/sap/ui/documentation/sdk/images/HT-1002.jpg and test-resources/sap/m/images/Woman_avatar_01.png, which the original resolves relative to the Demo Kit); the SVG item keeps the original's absolute www.sap.com logo URL verbatim.

the sap.f.ProductSwitch and sap.f.ProductSwitchItem controls (since UI5 1.72) are newer than 1.71 and are the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1. The sample's subject, ProductSwitchItem.imageSrc, is @since 1.140 (ProductSwitchItem.js), so the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.140.
